extracted.name: 5-Ingredient Crab Salad
extracted.description: This 5-ingredient crab salad recipe is made with imitation crab, sautéed green pepper, onion, and mayo for a creamy spread for crackers or sandwiches.
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a medium skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and green pepper; sauté until tender, about 3 minutes. Stir in crabmeat; saute 3 minutes more.
Transfer crabmeat mixture to a medium bowl. Fold in mayonnaise until well combined. Serve warm or cold.
